93:t_1:89.en:
$$ラルク$$
「A $$宇宙軍$$ soldier, huh. Isn't this a treaty violation?」

93:t_1:90.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Let's leave it at that, $$姫$$. This time I personally invited Colonel $$ハトリ$$.」

93:t_1:91.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The $$宇宙軍$$ says it wants to hear about the other day's incident. I figured it was easier to have them come here than for us to go to them.」

93:t_1:92.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You mean the $$宇宙怪獣$$ that dropped into the atmosphere...」

93:t_1:93.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Honestly... this isn't our world, and yet you still hide behind a treaty and claim extraterritoriality...」

93:t_1:94.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's just what we are, the $$フラタニティ$$.」

93:t_1:95.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Hmph... I was $$トップレス$$ as a child too, just like everyone else. Not enough to catch the $$フラタニティ$$'s attention, though.」

93:t_1:96.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Thanks to that, I was able to wake from the dream before it was too late.」

93:t_1:98.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Besides... if letting $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ into the atmosphere is the problem, isn't that the $$宇宙軍$$'s responsibility too?」

93:t_1:99.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「As I said before, this is not the world we came from. I can't deny that our defense systems have flaws as well.」

93:t_1:100.en:
$$チコ$$
「Then why not work with the people of this world and fight the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$?」

93:t_1:101.en:
$$チコ$$
「Or are you afraid of clashing with the $$サイデリアル$$?」

93:t_1:103.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's enough, $$チコ$$. I have business with the $$宇宙軍$$ too.」

93:t_1:104.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Will you finally approve the cooperation with us that we've requested time and again?」

93:t_1:105.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...The right of us to fight $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ separately from the $$宇宙軍$$ chain of command is guaranteed by treaty.」

93:t_1:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We $$トップレス$$ are humanity's only power to protect it from $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

93:t_1:108.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Only we can operate the $$バスターマシン$$s that fight $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...」

93:t_1:109.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「After all, the main power source of the $$バスターマシン$$s, the super energy of the $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$ that overwhelms $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$, is the $$トップレス$$ themselves.」

93:t_1:111.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「But it can also be thought of this way. The $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ attack because the $$トップレス$$ exist...」

93:t_1:113.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Even in old records, the emergence of the $$トップレス$$ coincides with the renewed invasion of the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

93:t_1:114.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「This is how I feel. ...Aren't you the same as them? Aren't both of you enemies of humanity...?」

93:t_1:117.en:
$$ハトリ$$
「Sooner or later, I intend to recommend abolishing every system related to the $$フラタニティ$$.」

93:t_1:118.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I see. Then let's get our business across quickly, before that.」

93:t_1:119.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We, the $$トップレス$$ of $$メガネビュラ$$...」

93:t_2:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

93:t_2:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Pardon me, if you please...! Pardon me, if you please!」

93:t_2:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Born unknown, parents unknown, raised in Mars's Valles Marineris canyon, the humble $$ノノ$$, a petty nobody, if you please!」

93:t_2:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone in $c, please, let this $$ノノ$$ share a cup with you too!」

93:t_2:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Back off, $$ノノ$$. We'll never get anywhere like this.」

93:t_2:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize, everyone in $c. Allow me to offer you our cooperation once more.」

93:t_2:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are you the commander of this unit?」

93:t_2:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're the $$フラタニティ$$. We have no such thing as a leader.」

93:t_2:14.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's an organization that gathers children with so-called super... powers, the $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_2:15.en:
$$カシオ$$
「The $$フラタニティ$$ is run basically by children alone, and adults can't interfere.」

93:t_2:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I brought everyone's luggage from $$メガネビュラ$$. And as coach, I have to greet everyone in $c properly.」

93:t_2:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$コーチ$$... you're one in title only...」

93:t_2:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You just mentioned the word $$トップレス$$. Is that power used in combat?」

93:t_2:20.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. Each person's ability has its own characteristics, though.」

93:t_2:21.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For example, mine is remote manipulation of matter, and $$ラルク$$ here has quantum transfer ability, and so on.」

93:t_2:23.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And the most important point is that our $$バスターマシン$$s are powered by the $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$ produced by the abilities of the $$トップレス$$.」

93:t_2:25.en:
$$マオ$$
「So you're saying that robot runs on your power?」

93:t_2:26.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Exactly. And that power is unrivaled in our world, and...」

93:t_2:27.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「it is also our greatest combat strength against the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

93:t_2:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「In your world, was there any fighting force besides the $$トップレス$$?」

93:t_2:29.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There was an organization called the $$宇宙軍$$. Some of them have been transferred to this world as well.」

93:t_2:30.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But it would be pointless to ask them for cooperation. Their main mission is intercepting $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$, and their composition is specialized for that.」

93:t_2:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So that's why you've kept up mutual non-interference with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

93:t_2:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Given that situation, I'll ask you to explain why you're offering to cooperate with us.」

93:t_2:33.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「First of all, we are the $$フラタニティ$$, and our right to act independently of the $$宇宙軍$$ is guaranteed. So this is purely our own will.」

93:t_2:34.en:
$$チコ$$
(Our, huh... Isn't it $$ニコラ$$'s will, more like...)

93:t_2:35.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And as members of this world, we learned that Earth's humanity has enemies other than the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

93:t_2:36.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$, then...」

93:t_2:37.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right. We decided to fight them to protect Earth's humanity.」

93:t_2:38.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We would very much like to cooperate with you, who are at the center of that fight.」

93:t_2:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「You weren't very cooperative at first, though...」

93:t_2:41.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize for that. The purpose was to gauge the abilities of the comrades we'll be fighting alongside from now on.」

93:t_2:42.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Once more, I apologize for our rudeness, and we'll cooperate with $c.」

93:t_2:43.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...We have no reason to refuse.」

93:t_2:44.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you. Now then, let me properly introduce the members of the $$フラタニティ$$.」
